**Finding: Compliant** (no redline proposed).

- The only MFN-type provision is § 7.6, which runs **in our favour** — Brightline warrants that fees charged to Northwind will be no less favourable than those offered to similarly situated customers, subject to a reasonable comparison qualifier ("comparable volumes and terms").
- I searched the fees section (§ 7), Order Forms (§ 4) and the wider document for any obligation on Customer to extend best terms to Vendor or match third-party offers; none exists.
- This satisfies the preferred position (no MFN obligation burdening Customer), and per the detection guidance a Vendor-granted MFN is welcome and must not be flagged.
